subject: READY_FOR_PRIMARY: consolidated P0 INNER first-open runtime correction dossier
body: Manager reconciliation of tickets 02/03/05/09 plus current-main source deltas. Disposition: READY_FOR_PRIMARY_RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_WITH_CI_AND_PHYSICAL_FIELD_GATE. Current main admits a real race: accepted WakeInner is queued on Dispatchers.IO under controller generation G; FoldOverlayService can immediately begin Gen3 opening visual; ordinary OPENING_FROM_CLOSED->INNER_HANDOFF increments generation, so a queued worker that starts afterward can reject itself and skip the Binder wake. Fix contract: mint attempt key (serviceEpoch, openingAttemptSequence); make privileged wake a one-shot attempt-scoped commit not revoked by ordinary handoff; split visual into immediate bounded PRELUDE then WAKE_COMMITTED-gated bridge; use exact-current readiness ledger through logical display/FIRST_PRESENTED/FIRST_USEFUL/FIRST_INTERACTIVE; keep physical power non-authoritative; keep 120Hz orthogonal; defer predictive prewarm until correctness/field validation. Ticket02 oracle 9/9 PASS; ticket03 revised adversarial model 100000 streams zero violations. Do not call fixed until CI + Fold7 attempt-correlated field proof.
